'2026-02-20 | SAI BABA INDUSTRIES | HULLED SESAME SEEDS 99.97 % ... | MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India -> Sokhna, EGYPT | 12074090 | BOL 9871336' and '2026-02-17 ... -> Manila North Harbor, PHILIPPINES | 12074090 | BOL 9755194'. Note: the two slugs appear to be the same Gwalior entity/related entity; shipment counts overlap and cannot be summed.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated Indian customs shipping-bill records with B/L numbers, HS 12074090 (hulled/raw sesame seeds) and named destinations (Iraq, Russia, Brazil, Egypt, Philippines) from Mundra/Kandla. Declared HS 120740 is consistent with the actual 12074090 — no HS correction needed. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused on all attempts and registry pages (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views: null, not estimated. Role: exporter/manufacturer-trader of sesame seeds (also appears as importer of Brazilian raw sesame, i.e. processing/re-export operation). No rejection grounds: entity is active in customs data through Feb 2026.
